_notes: Some DCS AH-64D command labels exported by Joystick Diagrams come through in Chinese instead of English. Investigated 2026-09-06: all 17 affected commands come from exactly one device (WINCTRL Orion Throttle Base II + TGRIP-F16) on exactly one profile (AH-64D pilot seat) - every other device (3 MFDs, ICP, stick) and both other AH-64D profiles (CPG, AI menu) export cleanly in English. DCS's own UI_LANGUAGE option is set to English (0) too. This points to SimAppPro (used to program that throttle) as the source of the Chinese labels, not a DCS-wide language/locale setting - matches Marky's own diagnosis. These translations were done directly (literal, standard DCS/helicopter terminology) rather than pulled from DCS's own official English command reference for this module, so flag anything that reads oddly. IMPORTANT: this table is for DISPLAY only. Anything that actually matches/looks up a binding (data/bindings/<aircraft>.json's command_map, and the runtime resolution code) must keep using the original left-hand string, since that's what will keep showing up in every future export unless the underlying SimAppPro/DCS issue gets fixed at the source.
